title: eludite.debug.sessions input
description: List the debugging sessions (brief 0028): Eludite debugs several processes at once, as Visual Studio does with multiple startup projects (eludite.debug.start with `compound`) or an attach beside a launch. Every eludite.debug.* command that acts on a session takes `session` (an id from this list) and defaults to the active one. Runs no debuggee code.
